product.summary: Launch page of Lumen, a fictional e-paper field notebook for people who think on paper and archive digitally: one product, three finishes, pre-orders.

audience.who: architects, researchers and journalists who still draft on paper
audience.environment: reading on a phone in transit, deciding on a laptop at night

requirements.text: The first screen says what the product is in one sentence and shows it; no carousel, no stock photo.
The page reads like a long-form article: a reader can scroll it in two minutes and understand the three ideas (paper feel, archive, battery).
The brand is warm paper and ink: cream and graphite with one ink accent; editorial typography with a real serif for headlines.
Pre-order is the one action; it is visible in every section without shouting.
Motion explains the product (the page opens like a notebook, a stroke draws itself) and never decorates; it respects reduced motion.
The page loads fast on a phone over mobile data: fonts self-hosted, images sized, no layout shift.
Everything reads at 320px and at 200% zoom; headlines stay on one line per idea.
Dark mode follows the system but the page is designed for light first (paper).

direction.statement:
Editorial and spacious: paper, ink and air. One large image per idea, serif headlines set tight, a single ink accent.
The page is a notebook spread: margins carry the small type, the centre carries the product.
Nothing is centred by default; asymmetry comes from the grid, not from decoration.
references: the typographic restraint of a well-made field guide
the pacing of a long-form essay with photographs
a stationer's catalogue: products shown flat, lit from one side

decisions.choice: Fraunces Variable (serif, optical sizing) for headlines at a 1.25 ratio up to a fluid display size; Inter Variable for body at 18px with 1.6 line height; measure 62 characters.
Cream canvas (#f6f1e8) and graphite ink (#1e1d1b) with one ink-blue accent (#1c4aa8) for links and the pre-order action; no gradients; status colours only in the form.
8px base with generous section spacing (96px to 160px) and tight spacing inside text blocks; the grid gutter is 32px.
Spacious: one idea per viewport on desktop, one per two viewports on a phone.

A 12-column grid with a 1280px measure; headlines start on column 2, images bleed to the right edge on alternate sections; the pre-order bar is a sticky footer on phones and a quiet header link on desktop.
Sharp: 2px on controls, 0 on images; the product's own corners are the only soft shapes.
Flat: no shadows except the pre-order dialog; depth comes from the photographs' lighting.
A notebook-open reveal on load (480ms, once), ink strokes that draw along scroll in the archive section (GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub), 200ms for hover and focus; reduced motion shows the final frames.
Rendered product shots on paper textures, one per idea, lit from the left; no people, no stock; images served in two sizes with fixed aspect boxes.
Links underline on hover; the pre-order button darkens one step; focus is a 2px ink ring with 3px offset so it reads on cream; form errors sit under their fields.
Follows the system: graphite canvas, cream text, accent lifted two steps; photographs keep their own tone.
Headings in order, one h1, landmark per section, the sticky bar never covers focused controls, targets 44px on the phone bar.
Breakpoints at 640, 900 and 1200 chosen by the measure: the two-column spreads become single columns under 900 with images first.

states.hover: underline links, darken the action one step

imagery.policy: rendered product on paper, lit from the left, two sizes per image with fixed aspect ratio boxes; no people, no stock
